subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: After preserving the canonical opt-in wake guard, should yielded-parent waiting become a permanent public `deferred` cron/protocol/plugin status, or remain internal task and lifecycle state?
rationale: The lifecycle bugs have mechanical fixes, but the branch also creates a persisted, externally typed status contract across protocol, CLI, UI, hooks, and plugins; code review cannot choose that permanent product contract safely.

options.title: Keep Waiting Internal
options.body: Preserve existing public status unions and represent yielded waiting through internal task state and diagnostics until final settlement.

options.title: Adopt Deferred Publicly
options.body: Accept `deferred` as a permanent status only with mixed-version, upgrade, plugin, CLI/UI, and live-channel proof.

options.title: Pause For Consolidation
options.body: Hold the PR until overlapping yielded-session work converges on one lifecycle owner and contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Waiting Internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public status unions and represent yielded waiting through internal task state and diagnostics until final settlement.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows broad ownership of subagent registry, task state, and handoff architecture across the affected boundaries.
